meta_description:
94K likes, 3,458 comments - kayla_itsines on September 25, 2026: "Do I have a story for YOUUUU! 
Wow. 

Imagine waking up and thinking it’s going to be a completely normal.. business as usual day … and then ONE conversation changes the entire trajectory of your life. 

All it took was one question, “do you have any advice for me?” 

Which turned into … 

1,000km bike ride from Gold Coast to Sydney, over 8 days, camping in the cold, raising money for mental health, with no expectation other than helping others and getting the chance to be in the same room as his idols. 

@mrlumore , it’s been an absolute HONOUR to watch this journey. You deserve this life. 

He said, “After losing my dad to dementia, seeing his life cut short - I’ve realised, life is short. I just want to prove to myself that I can do hard things whilst also raising money for a cause I am so passionate about and that’s so close to my heart”. 

To @steven and @tonyrobbins , it was heartwarming to watch you get around this incredible human. You’ve changed a young man’s life today and inspired thousands in that room to believe in themselves and their dreams. 

This is a story I’ll never forget 🙌🏼🫶🏼".
